_comment: Order 2001 belongs to cust_99, who is not in the conversation.
This fixture exists for one case and it is the nastiest one in the suite: a
signed-in shopper typing somebody else's order number. Every one of the
policy engine's eight checks passes — the tool is registered, the store has
the capability, the key has the scope, and the ownership gate returns true
because SessionIdentity.may_see trusts an authenticated session for its own
data. The word 'own' is doing all the work there, and it is the tool that
has to make it true by scoping the result to the session's customer id.
